story.title: One body of work. Many ways to hear it.
paragraphs: Star Splitter Records is the home of music written and directed by Jeff Hines. Rather than separating ideas by genre alone, each project explores a distinct musical identity with its own sound, visual language, and creative focus.
Some releases are original works. Others revisit earlier compositions through a new style, arrangement, or production approach. Each project offers another perspective on the same creative voice.

Where it matters, release notes explain how a piece came to exist. Its origins, its evolution, and the people who shaped the finished recording. They're there for anyone who's curious, without getting in the way of simply enjoying the music.

licensing.title: Music for picture.
licensing.intro:
Many releases are available as instrumentals, alternate mixes, stems, and other production-ready versions for film, television, games, podcasts, advertising, and digital media.

If you're looking for music with a particular mood or style, we'd love to hear about your project.

creditNote.title: Every piece of music came from a fully produced track, even if its been reinterpreted.
creditNote.body: All releases began as fully produced electronic compositions. Some are reinterpreted into different musical styles, use different instrumentation, arrangements, and other elements. Credits are clear for how it came to exist. Good ethics say I should be clear about when I'm using generative AI. The US copyright office has said that human contributions can be copyright protected.
